description: **The frozen-file rule misses a line with no leading pipe**: `warscape/policy.py` `retired_file_problems`: `C42 | 2026-11-06 | Liam | A stale row | yes` appended to a frozen decisions file passes `policy`, `--check` and `gates --fast`.
